scripts.test: pnpm -r --if-present test && cd contracts && forge test
scripts.abi: cd contracts && forge build && cd .. && for c in WatcherRegistry ExitPool Directory MemoBoard; do node -e "const j=require('./contracts/out/'+process.argv[1]+'.sol/'+process.argv[1]+'.json');require('fs').writeFileSync('packages/core/abi/'+process.argv[1]+'.json',JSON.stringify(j.abi,null,1))" $c; done
scripts.cbom: npx -y @qorechain/qorescan@0.1.0 scan --name wicketgate --network testnet --solidity contracts/src --tls rpc-testnet.qore.host:443 --out cbom/wicketgate.cdx.json
